brief:
Jumada al-Awwal, the fifth month of the Islamic lunar calendar, will commence in June 2026, Shehab Wire reported. The month corresponds to 1448 in the Hijri calendar.

The Islamic lunar calendar, which guides religious observances and holidays, shifts approximately eleven days earlier each Gregorian year due to the shorter lunar cycle of 354 days compared to the solar year of 365 days.
